gloss: LP record; vinyl album; long-playing record

definitions.explanation: A 33⅓ rpm vinyl record, typically 12 inches in diameter, holding around 20 minutes of music per side. Abbreviation of English "long-playing".

examples.japanese: {昔|むかし}のLPを{集|あつ}めている。
LPの{音|おと}はCDより{温|あたた}かいと{感|かん}じる{人|ひと}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Many people feel that LP records have a warmer sound than CDs.

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}{若|わか}い{世代|せだい}の{間|あいだ}でも、LPを{聴|き}くためにレコードプレーヤーを{買|か}う{人|ひと}が{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: Recently, even among the younger generation, more and more people are buying record players to listen to LPs.

notes:
Borrowed directly from English "LP" (long-playing). The Roman letters are read individually: え + る + ぴー.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- LPレコード: LP record (often written in full)
- LPを{聴|き}く: to listen to an LP
- LPを{集|あつ}める: to collect LPs
- {中古|ちゅうこ}LP: used/secondhand LPs
- LPジャケット: LP album cover/sleeve

SIMILAR WORDS:
- レコード: record — the general term for vinyl records
- アルバム: album — refers to a music release in any format
- シングル: single — short record, originally a 7-inch 45 rpm disc
- EP: EP — extended play, between a single and an LP in length
